observation: A second pre-upload adversarial audit found that P0v6 did not bind retained fold months to the frozen calendar, trusted validation scores and selected_non_frem without retaining validation laws for reconstruction, could ignore foreign files outside expected campaign globs, did not enforce acquisition-to-data receipt continuity at cell execution, and could report a downloaded bundle structurally verified without reconstructing isolated-install identity or the internal arithmetic of a claimed qualification. Algorithmic seed outputs were not required to share byte-equal outcomes. No official archive, market outcome, scientific cell or protected outcome had been accessed.
hypothesized_cause: P0v6 concentrated on raw test-score and policy reconstruction, leaving chronology, validation selection, complete-tree ownership and receipt-chain semantics distributed across producer assumptions instead of independently checked consumer invariants.
change: Freeze P0v7 as an evidence-chain-only amendment. Retain validation outcomes and finite laws; reconstruct validation scores and the selected non-FREM control; enforce exact frozen calendars, exact complete-campaign inventories, per-family gate consistency, unique cell claims and cross-seed outcome identity; require original acquisition receipts at scientific execution; reconstruct installed package identity, runtime allowlist, three-repeat maxima, byte stability and resource projections in downloaded qualification verification; distinguish bundle integrity from eligible_for_next_stage; and prevent verifier output from mutating the verified bundle.
predicted_effect: Misdated folds, outcome drift across seeds, favorable-control substitution, ignored extra attempts, broken acquisition chains, failed installations and arithmetically inconsistent qualification receipts will fail before selection, analysis or next-stage admission.
discriminating_experiment: Require 57 warning-strict tests including calendar, validation-law, selected-control, install, mode and projection tamper cases; Ruff; strict mypy; offline lock verification; notebook parsing; two byte-identical fixed-epoch v0.1.4 wheels; clean-wheel warning-strict generated execution; independent readback; and backward verification of the retained P0v5 smoke bundle.
